actions.name: reading
actions.text: a person holds both hands still in front of the chest with head bowed
paraphrases: a person keeps both hands together at chest height while looking down at them
a person stays mostly still with hands held in front and the head tilted down
a person holds the hands in front of the body and occasionally moves one sideways
actions.motion: Both forearms are raised so the hands are held close together in front of the chest or lap. The head tilts down toward the hands and stays there. The body is mostly still; occasionally one hand makes a short sideways sweep and returns.

phases.start: hands rise to the front of the chest
phases.middle: hands held still, head bowed toward them
phases.end: occasional short hand sweep or hands lower

confusable_with.name: play_with_phone_tablet
confusable_with.visible_difference: phone use has small repeated hand and thumb movements and hands held closer together

confusable_with.name: writing
confusable_with.visible_difference: writing has one hand making continuous small movements while the other stays still

confusable_with.name: counting_money
confusable_with.visible_difference: counting has repeated small movements of one hand passing over the other

actions.name: writing
actions.text: a person makes small continuous movements with one hand held low in front
paraphrases: a person moves the right hand in small strokes while the left hand stays still
a person leans over and moves one hand slowly across a surface in front
a person keeps the head bowed while the right hand makes short repeated movements
actions.motion: The person, often seated, leans the torso slightly forward with the head bowed. The right hand is held low in front of the body and makes small continuous movements, shifting gradually sideways. The left hand stays still nearby, and the rest of the body barely moves.

phases.start: hands placed low in front, head bows
phases.middle: right hand makes small continuous strokes

confusable_with.name: type_on_a_keyboard
confusable_with.visible_difference: typing moves both hands with small up and down taps side by side

confusable_with.name: reading
confusable_with.visible_difference: reading keeps both hands still and raised higher

confusable_with.name: cutting_paper
confusable_with.visible_difference: cutting paper holds both hands raised with one hand opening and closing

actions.name: tear_up_paper
actions.text: a person holds both hands together in front then pulls them sharply apart
paraphrases: a person brings two hands close at chest height and jerks them in opposite directions
a person repeatedly pulls the hands apart from each other in front of the chest
a person grips with both hands together then twists them away from each other
actions.motion: Both hands come together in front of the chest. One hand moves forward or up and the other moves back or down in a quick tearing motion, separating the hands slightly. The hands come together again and the motion repeats a few times, with the elbows bent and close to the body.

phases.start: hands meet in front of the chest
phases.middle: repeated quick pulling apart of the hands

confusable_with.name: fold_paper
confusable_with.visible_difference: folding moves the hands slowly together and presses rather than jerking apart

confusable_with.name: ball_up_paper
confusable_with.visible_difference: balling up squeezes the hands toward each other repeatedly

confusable_with.name: open_bottle
confusable_with.visible_difference: opening a bottle twists one hand above the other in a small circular motion

actions.name: put_on_jacket
actions.text: a person reaches one arm then the other backward behind the body
paraphrases: a person swings each arm back and down behind the body, one at a time
a person reaches back with one arm, then the other, and pulls shoulders forward
a person extends arms behind the body in turn and shrugs the shoulders up
actions.motion: One hand holds near the opposite shoulder while the other arm reaches down and backward behind the body, then extends forward. The first hand moves across behind the back and the second arm reaches back in the same way. The shoulders shrug and both hands pull forward at the chest at the end.

phases.start: one arm reaches back and down
phases.middle: second arm reaches back behind the body
phases.end: shoulders shrug, hands pull at the front of the chest

confusable_with.name: take_off_jacket
confusable_with.visible_difference: taking off pulls the arms forward out of the back, the reverse order

confusable_with.name: put_on_bag
confusable_with.visible_difference: putting on a bag uses one arm and lifts at the shoulder without the second arm reaching back

confusable_with.name: stretch_oneself
confusable_with.visible_difference: stretching extends both arms at once and holds them out

actions.name: take_off_jacket
actions.text: a person pulls the shoulders back and draws each arm forward from behind
paraphrases: a person pushes the shoulders back then pulls one arm forward, then the other
a person reaches across to the opposite shoulder and slides each arm out in turn
a person brings both arms behind the back and frees them one after another
actions.motion: Both hands go to the front of the chest and then to the shoulders, and the shoulders roll back. One arm straightens down and backward, then pulls forward while the other hand holds behind the back. The second arm then pulls forward and both hands come to the front of the body.

phases.middle: arms drawn back and pulled out one at a time
phases.end: both hands in front of the body

confusable_with.name: put_on_jacket
confusable_with.visible_difference: putting on reaches the arms backward into position, the reverse order

confusable_with.name: take_off_bag
confusable_with.visible_difference: taking off a bag lifts one strap off a single shoulder

confusable_with.name: cross_arms
confusable_with.visible_difference: crossing arms ends with forearms folded and held still at the chest

actions.name: put_on_a_shoe
actions.text: a person bends down and works with both hands at one foot
paraphrases: a person leans forward, lifts one foot, and moves both hands around it
a person brings both hands down to one foot and pushes the foot forward
a person, often seated, holds one foot with two hands and pulls upward
actions.motion: The person, often seated, bends the torso forward and raises or bends one leg. Both hands reach down to that foot and hold near it, making pulling motions upward toward the ankle. The foot pushes forward and down, then the person sits back up and lowers the foot.

phases.start: torso bends and hands reach to one foot
phases.middle: hands pull around the foot while foot pushes forward

confusable_with.name: take_off_a_shoe
confusable_with.visible_difference: taking off pulls the hands away from the foot and the foot draws back

confusable_with.name: pick_up
confusable_with.visible_difference: picking up reaches one hand to the floor briefly and rises without lifting a foot

confusable_with.name: squat_down
confusable_with.visible_difference: squatting lowers the hips with both feet on the floor and no hand activity at a foot

actions.name: take_off_a_shoe
actions.text: a person bends to one foot and pulls with both hands away from it
paraphrases: a person leans forward, grips near one foot, and draws the hands off it
a person lifts one foot slightly and pulls downward and away with both hands
a person, often seated, reaches to one ankle and pulls the hands away
actions.motion: The person, often seated, bends the torso forward and lifts or bends one leg. Both hands reach down to the heel area of that foot, then pull down and away from the foot while the leg draws back. The person straightens up and the hands come back up in front.

phases.start: torso bends and hands reach the foot
phases.middle: hands pull away while leg draws back

confusable_with.name: put_on_a_shoe
confusable_with.visible_difference: putting on pulls upward toward the ankle while the foot pushes forward

confusable_with.name: pick_up
confusable_with.visible_difference: picking up reaches one hand to the floor briefly without working at a foot

confusable_with.name: butt_kicks
confusable_with.visible_difference: butt kicks swing the heels up behind the body repeatedly while standing

actions.name: put_on_glasses
actions.text: a person brings both hands up to the sides of the face
paraphrases: a person raises two hands to the eyes and slides them back to the ears
a person lifts both hands before the face and moves them toward the temples
a person brings hands from the chest to the face, holding them near the ears
actions.motion: Both hands rise from in front of the chest toward the face, close together in front of the eyes. The hands then move apart and backward along the sides of the head toward the ears, and the head may tilt slightly forward. The hands then lower back down.

phases.start: both hands rise toward the face
phases.middle: hands move from the eyes back to the ears

confusable_with.name: take_off_glasses
confusable_with.visible_difference: taking off moves the hands from the ears forward and away from the face

confusable_with.name: put_on_headphone
confusable_with.visible_difference: headphones are placed with hands over the top of the head down to the ears

confusable_with.name: wipe_face
confusable_with.visible_difference: wiping makes repeated strokes across the whole face

actions.name: take_off_glasses
actions.text: a person raises hands to the sides of the face and pulls forward
paraphrases: a person lifts both hands to the temples and draws them forward and away
a person brings hands up near the ears then moves them out in front
a person reaches to the face with two hands and lowers them forward and down
actions.motion: Both hands rise to the sides of the head near the ears or temples. The hands move forward past the eyes and away from the face, coming together in front. The hands then lower to chest height or below.

phases.start: hands rise to the sides of the head
phases.middle: hands move forward away from the eyes
phases.end: hands lower in front of the chest

confusable_with.name: put_on_glasses
confusable_with.visible_difference: putting on moves the hands from the eyes backward to the ears

confusable_with.name: take_off_headphone
confusable_with.visible_difference: taking off headphones lifts the hands up over the top of the head

confusable_with.name: headache
confusable_with.visible_difference: headache holds hands on the head without moving them away

actions.name: put_on_a_hat_cap
actions.text: a person raises both hands above the head and lowers them onto it
paraphrases: a person lifts two hands over the head and presses down on top of it
a person brings both hands up to the top of the head and adjusts there
a person reaches above the head with both hands and pulls them down to it
actions.motion: Both arms lift so the hands are above the head. The hands move down to rest on top of the head, sometimes pulling down at the front and back. The head may tilt forward slightly, and then both hands lower to the sides.

phases.start: both hands rise above the head
phases.middle: hands lower onto the top of the head and press

confusable_with.name: take_off_a_hat_cap
confusable_with.visible_difference: taking off lifts the hands up and away from the top of the head

confusable_with.name: put_on_headphone
confusable_with.visible_difference: headphones end with the hands at the ears on the sides of the head

confusable_with.name: brush_hair
confusable_with.visible_difference: brushing hair uses one hand with repeated strokes along the head
